name: @pipeworx/mcp-asx-announcements

tools.name: asx_get_announcements
tools.description: List ASX company announcements for a listed Australian company by ticker: date and time (Sydney), headline, price-sensitive flag, page count, file size, a derived category (share_issue, unquoted_securities, cessation_of_securities, buyback, director_interest, substantial_holder, trading_halt, quarterly_cashflow, results, meeting, other) and a document link. Newest first. Source: ASX company announcements. Use asx_get_share_issues for dilution questions.

months.description: Look-back window in months (default 6). Ignored when year is given.

year.description: Full calendar year instead of a rolling window, e.g. 2025

tools.name: asx_get_share_issues
tools.description: Dilution view of a listed Australian company: ASX announcements that signal new or changed share capital - applications for quotation of securities (Appendix 2A), proposed issues (Appendix 3B), placements, share purchase plans, entitlement offers, unquoted securities (options and performance rights), cessations and buy-backs - with counts per category and per month. Classified from the announcement headline; share counts and prices are inside the linked PDF and are not extracted. Source: ASX company announcements.

months.description: Look-back window in months (default 6). Ignored when year is given.

year.description: Full calendar year instead of a rolling window, e.g. 2025

tools.name: asx_get_company
tools.description: Company details for an ASX-listed company by ticker: name, description, listing date, sector, head office, directors and secretaries, website, shares on issue, market capitalisation, last/bid/ask price, 52-week range, ISIN, latest dividend and headline financials. Source: ASX company information (delayed).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-asx-announcements forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the asx-announcements pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
